Overview

Copenhagen is a city in Capital Region with a population of 794,000. Denmark’s hygge-filled capital, a cycling paradise known for its colorful Nyhavn harbor, Tivoli Gardens, and Michelin-starred restaurants. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
